name: Harmonograph - Variations
description: Eight seeds side by side — the only surface where the variation envelope can actually be judged, since one figure either looks fine or it does not. What this sheet is watching for is specific: a lazy oval, a ball of thread, a trace that stopped where it started and reads as closed, and above all a blot where the pen spiralled into the middle. The caption carries the measured coverage of a deliberately collapsed draw beside a healthy one, so the degeneracy guard can be seen working rather than trusted.
